name: Graph DFS Components
summary: Model each email as a node and connect all emails within the same account. Two accounts belong together exactly when they share an email, so each connected component of the email graph is one merged account, found by depth-first search.
visualizationIntent: init: index every email as a node and add an edge between emails that appear in the same account; a shared email bridges two accounts. loop: DFS each unvisited email with an explicit stack, collecting the whole connected component. update: sort each component's emails and prefix the owner's name. return: the merged accounts.
